source_instruction: i'm looking for a 32 ounce package of gluten free almond flour.
query: I swear the barista at the corner café remembered my order today even though I haven’t stopped by in three whole weeks—they had my iced oat milk latte with an extra shot and just a dash of cinnamon waiting on the counter before I even finished pulling my wallet out of my bag. On the walk over, I passed that little community garden plot I’ve been watching all spring, and the first sunflower seedlings finally pushed up through the dirt, all bright and fuzzy with tiny little leaves, and someone had stuck a tiny hand-painted ladybug rock right next to the biggest sprout. I also noticed the stray tabby that hangs out by the laundromat was curled up on top of the warm dryer vent, napping so hard it didn’t even twitch when a kid zoomed by on a sparkly pink scooter yelling about ice cream. I’ve heard the pantry staples section carries options that are totally gluten free, that there’s that one size I always go for available there too. I’ve heard none of the picks there run too pricey, that none of them go over whatever I was comfortable with last time I picked this up, that they all stick to what makes sense for my budget.
